properties.name: WHAT WORKED (2026-09-29, 0.74.0): `--call` with `--graph-path` and a scratch HOME made isolated measurements possible and checkable twice in one day: the designer's cold-load timing of reflow2's own design, and this triage's reply-size probes. The scratch HOME stayed untouched. Do not regress it
properties.statement:
From art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item W1 (friction-log entry #26).

The designer timed a cold open of reflow2's own design (a copy in a scratch directory, isolated HOME, no hub config) with the INSTALLED 0.74.0 binary through `--call` and `--graph-path`, and confirmed afterwards that the scratch HOME was still empty.

The same door then served this triage (T2) for every refuting measurement of items I4, I5, I16 and I17: reply sizes of replace_text, set_decision_status and add_decision, the describe_schema TemporalFact reply, the add_decision related_to drop, and budget_report's refusal. All ran on a throwaway store, with nothing built and no live design touched.

It works because `--call` runs through the SAME server path a session uses. So a measured reply is the reply a session gets, not a paraphrase. That is the property to keep.
